Childebert I in 
Paris, 
Chlodomer in 
Orléans, and 
Chlothar I in 
Soissons. Theuderic inherited Metz in 511 at his father's death. Early in his reign, he sent his son 
Theudebert to kill the Scandinavian King 
Chlochilaich (Hygelac of
